answer: Reputation aggregates trusted endorsements through reciprocity-weighted transitivity and decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence must be renewed through sustained honest service. A freshly spawned Sybil identity lacks credible incoming trust, leaving its EigenTrust-style eigenvector centrality near zero; colluding identities cannot raise it without trusted paths, and it cannot meet consensus thresholds. A lantern at an inlet may reveal a passing comet, but a brief appearance earns no durable reputation.
